messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — pricing/packaging implementation: two high-priority dependency items blocking rollout. Need quick acks and any hidden blockers.
- Metering tag mapping for new 'pro-plus' tier (metering-service change).
- Contract grandfathering exceptions for existing entitlements (billing pipeline + legal).
Who can own each and confirm ETA?

Ryan (Eng): I can own the metering-service change. Reviewing now, estimate Wed EOD for code + tests. Quick Q: do we need to backfill historical tokens into the new tag? @Liam (Reporting)

Liam (Reporting): We should NOT rewrite historical usage. Plan: surface old usage under a 'legacy' tag so invoices remain auditable. That means a small reporting UI label change + preserve raw rows. ETA for report UI: Thu. No migration required.

Sana (Billing): Legal flagged the grandfathered customers — we need an explicit contract ID list to apply overrides. Billing can't programmatically skip enforcement without that. @Maya can you provide the list or escalate to Legal?

Maya (Product): I'll DM the contract IDs and add a note in the contract tracker. Also FYI quota enforcement granularity is changing from per-minute -> per-second for burst smoothing; this touches quota-service. @Olivia (Infra) can Dedicated customers keep their current behavior?

Olivia (Infra): Dedicated still uses quota-service but with tenant-level overrides. Change is backward-compatible; I'll add a feature flag and ensure no perf regressions. Plan: feature-flagged rollout, staging tomorrow, canary next week.

Ryan (Eng): Metering patch draft (short):
```
// add tier mapping in meter_config.yaml
pro-plus: { tag: "pro_plus", multiplier: 1.0 }
// record tag at ingestion time
POST /ingest { model, tokens, tag }
```
I'll open a PR and ping reviewers once tests pass. Need owners for code review: @Olivia for infra impact, @Liam for reporting schema.

Liam (Reporting): I'll do a quick schema pass. If we preserve raw events nothing else should break.

Sana (Billing): Once I get the contract IDs, I'll update billing rules and run a dry invoice generation in staging. Expect to need 1-2 biz days after I get the list.

Maya (Product): To summarize owners+ETAs:
- Metering tag mapping -> Ryan, Wed EOD (PR + tests)
- Reporting UI + schema check -> Liam, Thu
- Quota enforcement granularity -> Olivia, feature flag + staging tomorrow
- Billing contract override -> Sana, 1-2 biz days after IDs
Also action: Maya -> DM contract IDs to Sana + file in contract-tracker.

ops-bot: Deployment note: staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z for feature-flagged quota changes. CI will block on failing tests.

Olivia (Infra): Small heads-up: feature flag -> ensure metrics emitted: quota.granularity and quota.flag_state. I'll add dashboards.

Ryan (Eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/1234 — pinged reviewers. Leaving a TODO for integration test to assert tag on ingest event.

Maya (Product): Thanks. If anyone surfaces additional hidden deps (legal hooks, marketplace billing codes), call them out here. Otherwise I'll consider this the working checklist. :thumbsup:
